Key Results: Strengthen capacities of Slovak business community and NGOs in the EU and IFIs, including the UNDP procurement processes, with special emphasis on development projects and investments. The solid basis for the implementation of several innovative solutions have been developed. A portable medical device tested by S-Case in North Macedonia has been awarded and recognized by several partners like Startup Pre-Accelerator & Innovation Incubator Silicon Valley, Vodafone (“Idea of the Year”); Reflect Impact Awards 2020, among others. In 2021, the solution has been implemented by various NGOs and local partners in Albania, Serbia or Georgia.
